t.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>不只拆「并且」，元件上能选任何一条消去规则。分类讨论写成规则是 ⟦?A ∨ ?B; ⟦?A⟧ ⟹ ?C; ⟦?B⟧ ⟹ ?C⟧ ⟹ ?C。
t.en: <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref> takes apart more than “and”: any elimination rule can be chosen on it. Case analysis as a rule is ⟦?A ∨ ?B; ⟦?A⟧ ⟹ ?C; ⟦?B⟧ ⟹ ?C⟧ ⟹ ?C.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 每种情况里，目标的哪一边在已知里？
hint.en: In each case, which side of the goal is among the givens?
